prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the five banking frames of the MANTA — the second player hero ship, a ray-winged interceptor, the single most-seen sprite of Direct mode — laid out in a 2-row by 3-column grid (the sixth cell repeats the level frame so every grid position is filled). Make it the best, most detailed pixel-art fighter hull you can draw.

Design identity to keep exactly — a flat ray-winged interceptor, about 1.6:1 wider than tall, strict side view facing RIGHT: broad swept delta wings whose upper edges catch the light, a pale mint-lit upper wing face (#f0fff4) over a sage-green body (#c8e0d0) with deeper shadowed under-wings (#3a5a48), a smooth mid-green canopy (#40d070) edged in bright mint (#a8f8c0) with a small white-green glint at its upper left sitting on the centreline, deep panel seams aft and on the folded lower wing, twin orange thruster vents (#f8b030) at the aft (left) edge between the wing roots, and a long forked tail ray. All on a 1-px near-black green outline (#10281e). NO engine flame, NO exhaust trail — the flame is a separate sprite; the aft edge is clean.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 6 cells laid out as a 3×2 GRID (3-column by 2-row, reading left-right then top-bottom) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject at the same scale and position; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = FRAME 0 LEVEL flight — the hull dead level, nose pointing straight right. The subject lies within aspect 1.50:1 to 2.40:1.
  cell 2 = FRAME 1 SLIGHT CLIMB — the SAME hull tilted gently nose-up (a few degrees), the upper spine still lit; nothing else changes. The subject lies within aspect 1.50:1 to 2.45:1.
  cell 3 = FRAME 2 STEEP CLIMB — the SAME hull tilted nose-up harder (about fifteen degrees), the nose clearly higher than the tail, the aft fin foreshortened. The subject lies within aspect 1.55:1 to 2.50:1.
  cell 4 = FRAME 3 SLIGHT DIVE — the SAME hull tilted gently nose-down. The subject lies within aspect 1.50:1 to 2.45:1.
  cell 5 = FRAME 4 STEEP DIVE — the SAME hull tilted nose-down hard (about fifteen degrees), mirror of the steep climb. The subject lies within aspect 1.55:1 to 2.50:1.
  cell 6 = FRAME 0 AGAIN — the LEVEL hull drawn once more, identical to cell 1 (this sheet repeats the level frame so every grid cell is filled — it is deliberate, not a new pose). The subject lies within aspect 1.40:1 to 2.30:1.
- BANK-ANGLE LAW: the five cells are one hull on a five-step tilt ladder — level, slight climb, steep climb, slight dive, steep dive — all the SAME length and thickness, the tilt carried by the nose and tail rows and by the folded wing rays only. Cells 1 and 2 are nearly identical; that is correct, do not invent new parts.
- ASPECT AND BORDER LAW: each hull is a plump wedge: it fills 85% of the cell's HEIGHT (a thick hull, tall in its cell) and its length must stop at LEAST 50 px short of both cell side borders — at least 50 px of unbroken flat key lies to the left of the tail and to the right of the nose. The hulls are SEPARATE islands of ink; none may approach a cell edge or a gutter. Width is NEVER more than twice the height.
- THICKNESS LAW: the hull is a FAT solid wedge — its height is at least HALF its length (a hull about 320 px long stands 150-170 px tall in its cell), a heavy machine, never a knife-edge sliver.
- EQUAL-BORDER LAW: each hull is DEAD-CENTRE in its cell with the SAME flat-key border on its left as on its right (at least 45 px each side) — the hulls are six independent islands on a still pond; they must NOT chain nose-to-tail across the gutters and must NOT lean toward the right side of their cells.
- GRID LAYOUT: 3 columns × 2 rows. TOP row left-to-right = cells 1,2,3; BOTTOM row left-to-right = cells 4,5,6. Each hull sits dead-centre in its own grid cell, a separate island of ink, never touching a cell border.
- SAME SUBJECT LAW: every cell shows the SAME subject, the same size, the same materials and colours, at the same position in its cell — only the named attitude changes between cells.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 1152×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 6 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge

notes:
s-manta (gen11 quality-regen wave 4, PROBE-OK@6; w15-REING11): ships/manta v2 (5 bank frames 24x15 native, playerBankFrame order level/climb/steep-climb/dive/steep-dive; the MANTA hull, facing right, no flame — the thruster is its own sprite; hitFlash false, no @flash sibling). the five bank cells cropped to their measured subject boxes with the 6-px key border clamped inside each cell (cell 6, the level-frame repeat, discarded); ARs 2.19–2.22 uniform, the sheet on the 3x2-of-384x256 grid on the flat #51e018 key. Replaces the R6-03 winners PNG (quality-regen wave 4 under the aspect-fill law); the #acbe9f light-hull census colour the ship-select spec samples survives the quantise. The design carries its own outline, so the outline pass is off.
